content: Value scanners: price a fair probability, compare to slower book odds, flag gap (EV = p*odds-1 after no-vig). Commercial scanners sort by edge %, benchmark against sharp closing line (Pinnacle), show EV before it disappears, alert in seconds. Table stakes: sorted list with edge/EV, market, kickoff time, odds freshness timestamp/age, filter by league/market/min-edge, link to fixture. Honest states: stale odds (entry age warning, fail-closed past threshold), overround above cap suppressed, lineup-freshness gate, no comparable fair price. Anti-features: auto-bet, urgency framing, presenting edge as guaranteed profit, surebet/arb positioning when model probability (not arbitrage) is the basis.
